source.b_shot: Independent generated animated diamond/diagonal-gradient shot; fx_gate_kit.distinct_shot v1

methodology.defaults: All catalog visual defaults, including experimental; only parallax model/cache resources relocated
methodology.alpha: Range/finite/shape every frame; exact alpha for colour-only items; opaque coverage and hidden-RGB probes at frames 0,24,47
methodology.edges: Advisory border-gradient ratios; warnings require dense replicated texture >=4 px in local edge windows (v2)
methodology.endpoints: Exact A/B identity, swapped endpoints, and p=1e-5 / 1-1e-5 limits; mean associated RGBA error <=1/255
methodology.flicker: qa_media on decoded MP4, no effect exemptions
methodology.determinism: Two complete raw RGBA render hashes
methodology.black: Visible mean luminance <5/255 or no coverage
